quarterly_data.signal: Diagnostics: Denka will provide 30,000 tests of its Ebola virus antigen rapid diagnostic kit 'QuickNavi-Ebola' (developed with Hokkaido University; Japanese marketing approval, approved in the DRC in June 2024) to the Democratic Republic of the Congo through JICA at the request of the DRC's INRB; an initial batch of 2,000 tests was provided, of which 550 were handed over on September 22, and the kit was confirmed to react to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus of the current outbreak; results in approximately 10 minutes, room-temperature storage.
